editorial:
Imagine you are a young real estate agent just trying to make a name for yourself. You get a job to sell a house with a weird history, and things go south fast when you meet a strange girl who has run away from home. You think you are doing a good thing by helping her, but you end up bringing something evil into your own life. The vibe here is really creepy and slow-burn, making you feel like something is always watching from the corners of the room. It starts off as a simple drama about helping a kid, but it quickly turns into a scary ride that drags in your family too.

The acting is great and makes the scary parts feel real. You will love how the tension builds up, though some people might find the beginning a bit slow. If you like movies that mess with your head and have a big twist, you need to see this.
endingExplained: You find out the young girl was actually a vessel for a demon. The demon tricks Leigh into letting it into her life so it can take over a new body. In the end, the demon successfully jumps from the girl into Leigh. The movie wraps up with the realization that the evil force won and is now hiding inside one of the sisters, leaving you with a chilling feeling that the nightmare is just beginning.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves supernatural thrillers with a dark twist.
